authority: Joe + Chett approved additive context-independent foundation following the L6-S1 business-bound media HOLD.

architecture.identity: Independent UUID canonical video resource; no required tenant or business on user-owned resources.
architecture.principal: Existing Supabase Auth user ID verified through the existing /auth/v1/user contract. No new identity catalog or login flow; business headers and editable user metadata do not grant ownership.
architecture.ownership: Discriminated user or tenant/business owner. Creation as another user is denied. Business authority reuses app_members and resolveStaffAccess/customers.manage, including established initial-owner configuration supplied by the host.
architecture.provenance: submittedBy is the authenticated introducer; creator is descriptive metadata, not authority. Legacy adoption records originalSubmitter as unknown when unavailable. Business ownership describes platform control, not a copyright adjudication.
architecture.source: Separate provider-neutral opaque managed/external/legacy reference. No URL fetching, embedding, token issuance or playback adapter is introduced. Existing legacy bytes remain in their original store.
architecture.compatibility: Unique (tenant,business,video) mapping to resource UUID; resource_id is not unique in the mapping model. Adoption is serialized and repeatable. Existing video ID, URL, publication, categories, collections and bytes are unchanged. This is an additive mapping, not a replacement read path.
architecture.lifecycle: Standalone resources may be archived with revision check and audit; no hard deletion or ownership transfer. Archiving a mapped legacy resource is explicitly rejected until coordinated lifecycle withdrawal is implemented.
architecture.entitlements: Existing business-scoped entitlement authority remains untouched. No media entitlement catalog, access evaluator or consumption behavior added.
architecture.boundary: Generic media core; existing database schema/runtime names occur only in the compatibility adapter and proposal foreign keys. No business-name branching or Vega/PDX-specific resource identity.

verification.layer5: Existing media and organized-library suites pass for Vega and Willow; a compatibility test also proves adoption leaves member projection and private playback unchanged.
verification.postgres: Repository rollback/release tested with a controlled connection. SQL proposal and repository have NOT been executed against PostgreSQL; database constraints, RLS/grants, concurrent adoption and live session integration still require Development verification before activation.
verification.browser: No browser changes or new hosted verification in this local foundation slice.
verification.provider: Authentication tests use controlled responses; no live authentication request or provider mutation performed. Official documentation was read only.

reviewBeforeActivation: Apply reviewed additive schema through established Development migration workflow and verify grants/RLS under restricted runtime identity.
Verify auth.users and business foreign keys, rollback, duplicate/concurrent adoption and nonexistent references on actual PostgreSQL.
Verify adoption against bounded Development videos with before/after business-state comparison; do not bulk-convert records.
Owner permission is enforced in the service; database adds owner or scoped staff defense in depth. Browser roles receive no schema/table access. Confirm this permission shape before applying.
stop: Await Joe + Chett review. No L6-S1B or L6-S2 started.
